sent_to_model:
right so my mate Jonno who used to be on grill with me moved to london in feb and he reads my little blog (like 40 ppl read it lol, mostly him and my mum). he keeps messaging asking what happened with the coolroom on cup week cos he saw my story. cbf typing it all out to him so want to do it as a blog post and just send him the link. basically written to him, take the piss out of him a bit, he would of lost his mind if he was there. chucked everything below, sorry its all over the shop just finished a double. dont make it a sob story its funny now. also dont put the bit about Raff's dad in, thats his business

- coolroom compressor died overnight Mon 2–Tue 3 Nov 2026; found it at 6.40am on Cup Day, Tue 3 Nov, thermometer said 11 degrees
- Cup Day lunch was 140 covers booked, set menu, 3 course
- fridge guy (Wally from Coldline) couldnt come till Wed, part coming from Sydney
- moved everything into the 2 undercounters, the bar fridge, and Marta's cafe next door let us use half her walk in
- lost about 1800 bucks of stock, mostly dairy and the duck legs
- head chef Raff was away on Cup Day so it was me running it
- me and Benny carried 30kg of beef shin down the laneway on a milk crate trolley in the rain, one wheel fell off
- dishy Kev filled the old esky with ice from the servo, 14 bags, the servo guy asked if we were having a party
- had to 86 the panna cotta at 12.15 so dessert became 'affogato with whatever' and people loved it more??
- a lady on table 9 asked if the beef was 'free range from the laneway' cos she saw us out the window
- Marta made us pay her back in croissant credit, I owe her like 3 weeks of staff meal
- my horse in the sweep was called Ice Cold Lad and came 2nd last, the universe is taking the piss
- bistro kitchens run on bar fridges and spite
- Jonno is soft now, london has made him soft, he'd of cried
- the owner (Phil) saying 'just make it work mate' is not a plan
- honestly best service we did all year, everyone was locked in
- written to Jonno like a letter but its a blog post
- funny, a bit of shit talking him
- leave out the stuff about Raff's dad being in hospital, thats why he was off, not my story
- end with something like come home ya flog

(About me: sous-chef at a busy bistro, 29, Melbourne, Australia. Length: it should come to roughly 800-2,000 words.)

must_cover: Retells the Cup Day coolroom failure and how the team managed service.
Addresses Jonno as the intended reader and teases him about how he would have handled the kitchen chaos.
must_not_reveal: That Raff's father was in hospital, or that a family illness is why Raff was away.

reference.kind: a model-written solution, used only to show the checks can be met
